# cloudxino_dns_record (Resource)

A record in a hosted DNS zone. Import with `<zone_id>/<record_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudxino_dns_record" "www" {
  zone_id = cloudxino_dns_zone.example.id
  name    = "www"
  type    = "A"
  content = cloudxino_server.web.ip_address
  ttl     = 300
}

resource "cloudxino_dns_record" "mail" {
  zone_id  = cloudxino_dns_zone.example.id
  name     = "@"
  type     = "MX"
  content  = "mail.example.com"
  priority = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String)
- `type` (String) A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA, ...
- `zone_id` (String)

### Optional

- `name` (String) `@` for the zone itself, or a name relative to it (`www`).
- `priority` (Number) MX and SRV only.
- `ttl` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import cloudxino_dns_record.www <zone_id>/<record_id>
```
